thread:
Alex: incident bot paged us for a KV eviction spike, happening during a rolling deploy. quick summary: sustained spikes peaking >120 evictions/s on some shards and a handful of 500s on search API.
Oncall Bot: Incident created INC-2026-0315-13 · paging group: #eng-oncall · link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0315-13
Mira: taking primary. looking at per-shard eviction metrics and pod mem/cgroup configs now. pinging infra to see if any recent config pushes.
Jamal: saw churn on inference-prod-4; eviction pattern looks like LRU thrash after memory limit change at last rollout.
Beth: CX flagged increased 500s from a handful of customers — triage opened and support looped in. tagging @support.
Mira: mitigation plan: restore previous cache-memory override on one node group and roll slowly (one node at a time). starting restart on node a-12.
Alex: suggestion to reduce alert noise while we stabilize: require a sustained window (3m) and raise per-node threshold to 85% so short deploy blips don't page.
Jamal: +1. also propose a temporary deploy suppressor: if deploy-tag present, suppress pages for 10m to avoid storms during planned rollouts.
Mira: live update — restarted node a-12, eviction rate down ~70% on that shard, search 500s dropped. holding for 10m to confirm.
Oncall Bot: deploy-detector: recent deploy to inference-service by ci-bot at 1769994200 (tag: rollback-candidate=false)
Beth: action items: update runbook for kv-evictions to document deploy-suppressor, clear ownership for alert tuning (oncall primary + eng-runtime). runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-evictions
Alex: ops YAML proposal to avoid repeat noisy pages (please review):
```
alert_name: kv-eviction-high
expr: avg_over_time(kv_eviction_rate[3m]) > 85
for: 3m
labels:
  tier: urgent
  owner: eng-runtime
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/kv-evictions
  dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/d/kv-evictions
```
Mira: also want a dashboard panel that correlates cache_size_bytes, eviction_rate, and deploy_tag. I'll mock a panel and post a link to the dashboard PR.
Jamal: I'll own the runbook edit + alert PR into ops-alerting. will include a 'deploy=true' label that triggers suppressor rule. assigning to @eng-runtime for review.
Beth: I'll update the customer status and keep CX informed; if errors stay low for 30m we'll close the ticket.
Alex: after PR merges let's add an automated 'quiet window' policy: if label deploy=true then squelch pages for 15m. SRE to validate that this won't hide real incidents (we'll keep dashboards and slack threads visible).
PM-bot: Task created: /tasks/1234 'Add deploy-suppressor to kv-eviction alert and update runbook' · assignee: Jamal · due: 1769998800
Mira: thanks all. I'll post a short timeline into the runbook with annotations (what we saw, mitigation steps, metrics before/after).
Alex: closing out here once runbook PR and alert PR land. great response — persistent but focused:thumbsup:
